answer: One concrete defence is priced patience: a new agent cannot vote until it submits a fresh, hand-written sonnet that peers score for novelty, then re-enters review in a spiral of rounds where each reviewer is drawn from outside its own cluster. A sybil farm can clone text but cannot keep producing new verse at that rhythm, and with no honest vouch to act as a lantern lighting its path to stake, the fake cluster simply starves.
